context: Tests the migrate-to-plugin skill's judgment core: after the deterministic manifest migration, the agent must reconcile leftover 'tile' wording, renaming package-sense prose to 'plugin' while leaving live contract surfaces untouched. A baseline agent told to 'migrate to plugin form' tends to blanket find-and-replace tile->plugin, which breaks the v1/tiles REST route, code identifiers, and the factual legacy tile.json reference. The discriminating behavior is distinguishing prose from contract — the keep criteria carry the most weight because that is where a naive sweep fails.

checklist.name: Runs the migration mechanics
checklist.description: The plan converts the manifest with `tessl plugin migrate` (or the skill's migrate script), renames `.tileignore` to `.tesslignore`, and removes the now-obsolete root `tile.json`. Fails if it skips the conversion, hand-writes plugin.json, or leaves tile.json in place as the live manifest

checklist.name: Renames package-sense prose to plugin
checklist.description: The README's 'Widgets tile for ACME' becomes 'Widgets plugin for ACME' and '12 steering rules' becomes '12 rules'. Fails if the package-noun prose is left as 'tile' or the 'steering rules' framing is kept

checklist.name: Renames the tessl tile CLI alias
checklist.description: `tessl tile info` in check-publish.sh becomes `tessl plugin info` (the canonical command alias). Fails if the CLI invocation is left as `tessl tile`

checklist.name: Keeps the v1/tiles API route
checklist.description: The `tessl api v1/tiles/<workspace>/<name>/versions/<version>` route is left unchanged — it is a live REST endpoint, not prose. Fails if the plan rewrites it to `v1/plugins/...` or otherwise alters the `v1/tiles` path

checklist.name: Keeps code identifiers
checklist.description: The `tileRegistry` variable and `fetchTile` function in registry.ts stay as-is — renaming identifiers is out of scope and risks breaking call sites. Fails if the plan renames either identifier to a 'plugin' form

checklist.name: Keeps the legacy tile.json reference
checklist.description: The CHANGELOG line 'Migrated the build from a hand-written tile.json' keeps the literal `tile.json` — it is a factual historical reference to the old manifest filename. Fails if the plan rewrites it to plugin.json, which would make the entry false

checklist.name: Distinguishes prose from contract rather than blanket-replacing
checklist.description: The plan treats the edits per-occurrence (renaming prose, preserving contracts) rather than proposing a global s/tile/plugin/ across the repo. Fails if it describes or implies an undifferentiated find-and-replace
